pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions during active drawdown; scaling in only permitted on confirmed momentum continuation after a 2R profit buffer is locked.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry allowed unless the ATR(14) expansion ratio exceeds 1.2 and multi-timeframe directional bias aligns across M5 and M15.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate dynamic trailing stops once open profit hits $5.00, scaling out partial volume at $15.00 and letting runners stretch to $30.00.
